record.title: Conference-matrix MDS code conjecture
record.statement: Let $p$ be a prime, and let ${\mathbb C}$ be a code of length $p+1$ constructed from a generator matrix that is a conference matrix. **Conference-matrix MDS conjecture.** The code ${\mathbb C}$ is an MDS code of dimension $\frac{p+1}{2}$ and minimum Hamming distance $\frac{p+3}{2}$. This would give an MDS code with parameters determined by the rank of a conference matrix over ${\mathbb Z}_p$; the source provides no resolution of the claim.
record.source_name: Tuvi Etzion, Alexander Vardy and Eitan Yaakobi, “Coding for the Lee and Manhattan Metrics with Weighing Matrices”, arXiv:1210.5725 (2012).
record.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1210.5725

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2012).

record.title: The spectral characterization of geodesic growth for right-angled Coxeter groups on trees
record.statement: Let $T$ and $T'$ be trees. Assume that they are simultaneously co-spectral, their complements are co-spectral, and their line graphs are co-spectral. **Geodesic-growth conjecture.** Then $T$ and $T'$ have the same geodesic growth, meaning that the associated right-angled Coxeter groups $G(T)$ and $G(T')$ have the same geodesic growth series. The conjecture asks whether these three spectral data determine geodesic growth for right-angled Coxeter groups based on trees; the paper establishes examples supporting the question but does not resolve the general implication.
record.source_name: Laura Ciobanu and Alexander Kolpakov, “Geodesic growth of right-angled Coxeter groups based on trees”, arXiv:1504.02774 (2020).
record.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1504.02774

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2015).

record.title: Conjecture on the ordered continued-fraction coefficients of quadratic integers
record.statement:
Let

$$
\Delta=[\overline{a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{l-1}}]
$$

be a purely periodic quadratic integer, and let $\mathcal{C}(\Delta)=\\{a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{l-1}\\}$. For each positive integer $n$, let $w_n$ be the $n$-th largest element of $\mathcal{C}(\Delta)$. **Quadratic-integer coefficient conjecture.** The ordered coefficients satisfy

$$
w_n\leq\frac{a_0}{n}.
$$

The conjecture proposes quantitative control of all continued fraction coefficients of a purely periodic quadratic integer. The preceding corollary establishes only the bound $a_i\leq a_0$ for the coefficients of $\sqrt d$; the stronger assertion for general purely periodic quadratic integers is left open in the source.
record.source_name: Thomas Lachmann and Jaspar Wiart, “On the area of empty axis-parallel rectangles amidst 2-dimensional lattice points”, arXiv:2109.11222 (2021).
record.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.11222

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2021).
